## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 2 févr. 2026 - 13 juil. 2026

         **Exemples d'avis:**

Apart from those, its perfect! I've noticed that you can't change the order of the tasks in checklists or rename them without starting again, and the back button during the workout menu doesn't work. ilI would also love to see some improvement of the actual workouts. If I could change the reps and weights without having to go back and edit the workout it would be much better."
